issues.description: In Exercise 2 (Grover with auxiliary qubit) the problem statement and method documentation ask students to "simulate the circuit and return the simulation counts" (i.e., a histogram/dict of measurement outcomes), but the template method signature for simulate() is annotated to return list[complex]. The template's simulate() return type annotation therefore conflicts with the described/expected return type and with the solution implementation which returns a dict[str,int]. This mismatch can confuse students (especially those using static type checking or relying on the signature) about what to implement and what tests expect.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the return type annotation of the template simulate() method in template_repository/ex2_grover_multi_qubit_with_auxiliary_qubit.py to match the intended output (dict[str, int]) and adjust the docstring accordingly. Example: def simulate(self, qc: QuantumCircuit) -> dict[str, int]: """Simulate and return measurement counts.""". This aligns the template signature with the problem statement and the provided solution.
